title: mentha arvensis f. neesiana
intro: Mentha arvensis f. neesiana, commonly known as Japanese peppermint or Japanese wild mint, is a subspecies of the mint plant that is native to East Asia, particularly in Japan and China. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing nausea and vomiting, relieving digestive issues, and providing anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha arvensis f. neesiana include its ability to act as a carminative, relaxant, and expectorant, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, limonene, and carvone, which contribute to its medicinal and culinary uses.
